headline: B4a (B2f + --aug_apm_p 0.3, WebRTC NS pass on 30 % of training clips) is not the new best. exploop/B4/iter01/verdict.json gives: merge (objective) run 92.55227928958006 vs base 91.97880641320396, delta 0.5734728763761012, CI [-0.008530328907396795, 1.1655467607844505], clean_drop -0.12025151349281771, verdict "above band, CI includes 0", decision drop; final run 93.15279926126122 vs 92.13685698540242, delta 1.015942275858805, CI [0.4293057843536239, 1.6017211297401048], verdict "positive", decision drop; new_best false on both, so B2f stays the reference under the screen design (new_best_delta 100). The pre-registered mechanism did not appear. scripts/b4_dsp_slices.py (run in this session) gives NS DiD +0.49 on the final readout, above the +0.32 refute line, so the lever verdict is REFUTED (provisional, 0 placebo arms), and falsifier (1) fires because the outcome escape is False (heldout F1 +0.30 merge / +1.04 final). The WF1 gain comes mostly from sim_matched_v1 (+1.24 [+0.19, +2.39] / +1.56 [+0.52, +2.65]) and from clean ranking (EER 3.42 -> 2.11), not from the targeted heldout NS slices. Every guard held.
went_ok: Final-epoch readout positive on the wave rule: +1.02 [+0.43, +1.60], with clean F1 up +0.35 [+0.05, +0.65] (verdict.json, compare_ci_vs_B2f-ep8.json)
Matched set gained broadly: +1.24 / +1.56 F1 with CIs excluding 0, F1 up in 23 of 23 matched slice rows at the merge, bona recall +3.32 / +4.86
Clean improved instead of paying: EER 3.42 -> 2.11 (merge) and 3.33 -> 2.21 (final); clean bona 28 fixed / 9 broken at ep8
Operating point now at 0.5 on the final readout: calibration gap noisy 0.05 (B2f 0.71), and one global threshold shift recovers only 0.01
Half-B noisy bona false alarms fell 213 -> 192 (merge) and 210 -> 177 (final); level_flip_bona 1.54 -> 0.87 (merge)

Clean experiment: one factor, NS selftest PASS, realised NS dose 0.298-0.302 per epoch and class-balanced, no traceback or failed( line, nothing pruned, +0.07 GPU-h; no guard fired (NS-offline spoof misses 20/15 <= 29, ep1 TrainAcc 86.88, ep8 TrainLoss 0.0562)
went_wrong: Hypothesised mechanism refuted on the primary readout: NS DiD +0.49 [-0.21, +1.22] (refute line +0.32); on half B, untreated offline heldout bona gained +5.4 / +7.3 recall against +2.1 / +2.8 for NS-treated; falsifier (1) fires (outcome escape False)
Objective (merge) readout misses the promote rule: CI low -0.01; heldout +0.30 [-0.84, +1.51]; on half A the merge's heldout F1 fell 89.69 -> 88.46
Heldout English got worse: full-set F1 -3.01 / -1.81, half-B bona recall 59.7 -> 56.6 at the merge; 0 English false alarms removed at the merge against 21 Chinese
Heldout spoof misses rose on half B: 16 -> 23 (merge) and 14 -> 19 (final), concentrated in English (3 -> 10) and online (5 -> 11); the PLC spoof-miss guard sits at 23 of 26

Saturated core barely moved: 69 % of final-readout noisy bona false alarms sit at p >= 0.99; noise_only and sil_only bona-source probes are still 100 % spoof (sil_only mean dP +0.8985 -> +0.9203 at ep8)
Final beats merge by +0.60 on half B (93.15 vs 92.55); merged epochs 4 and 5 (mini WF1 92.16 / 92.09) dilute it; the curve is still rising at epoch 8
largest_remaining_error: Confident noisy bona false alarms, half of them English, plus a rising heldout spoof-miss count. On half B, English is 95 of 192 (merge) / 91 of 177 (final) noisy bona false alarms, from 258 of 782 noisy bona. Heldout English bona recall is 56.6 / 58.9, against 78.6 / 80.5 for Chinese. 59 % / 69 % of noisy bona false alarms sit at p_spoof >= 0.99. Heldout spoof misses rose 16 -> 23 / 14 -> 19. Threshold or calibration is worth at most 0.01 on the final readout, so what remains is ranking.

proposals.targets: Heldout online-PLC bona contrast (B2f final recall T/C 67.5/75.6, gap +0.95), heldout F1 87.92/88.27, and the online heldout spoof misses that B4a raised (half B 5->11 / 4->9). Queued iteration b in wave.json lever_queue.
proposals.hypothesis: Packet-loss concealment artefacts are read as synthesis. Exposing both classes to libopus PLC under bursty loss on 30 % of codec calls makes concealment class-neutral. B4a never saw a dropped packet, yet already reached online-PLC DiD -0.50 (final) / -0.61 (merge), so the PLC effect must exceed that placebo level.
proposals.predicted_signature: Online-PLC DiD < -0.57 and below B4a's -0.50 (final); heldout F1 delta >= +0.5 on both readouts; matched qq/wechat bona recall each down <= 6 from 61.62/71.15; PLC spoof misses <= 26/25; clean F1 within 0.5 of 97.60/97.69.
proposals.falsifier: Online-PLC DiD >= -0.57 AND heldout F1 delta < +0.5 on either readout -> drop. WF1 delta < -0.5 with ep1 TrainAcc < 85.36 or ep8 TrainLoss > 0.0752 -> under-fit, drop.

proposals.targets: Pause-rich saturated noisy bona false alarms (B2f full final 66/76/107 by non-speech tertile) and sil_only bona at 100 % spoof (mean dP +0.8929/+0.8985). Queued iteration c.
proposals.hypothesis: Part of the saturated core is 'gated or non-speech content => spoof'. Class-independent DTX gating makes gated pauses class-neutral. B4a already scores drop_high - drop_low = +10 on the full set (z +3.51) but -8/-5 on half B, so the gating effect must go beyond what NS exposure already did.
proposals.predicted_signature: Criterion (ii) >= +5 on the full set (final) and above B4a's +10, and >= 0 on half B for both readouts; VAD DiD < -0.57 and below B4a's -0.22/-0.54; sil_only bona mean dP below +0.8929/+0.8985; clean F1 within 0.5.
proposals.falsifier: Clean F1 down > 0.5, half-B noisy spoof misses > 36/35, or VAD spoof misses > 25/22 -> drop. A null on (ii) and VAD reads 'inconclusive (under-dosed)' per the README dose rule.

proposals.targets: The generic gain B4a showed on matched/clean (matched +1.24/+1.56, clean EER -1.31/-1.12) and the merge CI that missed 0 (low -0.01). Candidate for iteration d if opus_plc is not positive.
proposals.hypothesis: B4a's WF1 gain is a generic augmentation effect of the NS pass, not suppressor-artefact neutralisation. The evidence: the NS contrast is refuted; untreated bona gained more than treated; matched has no NS stage yet rose in 23/23 slices; dev loss was lower than B2f's at every epoch. Doubling the dose should then increase the gain.
proposals.predicted_signature: Merge delta vs B2f > +0.5 with CI low > 0; final half_B WF1 >= 93.15; matched F1 >= 92.46/92.80; clean within 0.5; ep8 dev loss <= 0.1166; offline-NS spoof misses <= 29.
proposals.falsifier: Final delta vs B2f < +0.5, or matched F1 more than 1.0 below B4a's -> no dose response, B4a's gain was not dose-driven (or was seed noise); drop apm_ns. Heldout English half-B bona recall below 56.6/58.9 or heldout spoof misses above 23/19 -> more NS trades heldout for matched.

proposals.targets: Heldout afftdn bona (half-B recall 58.1 -> 62.2 in B4a, B2f full-set recall 62.6 against 75.9 for anlmdn), the only NS-specific signal B4a showed.
proposals.hypothesis: afftdn is the harsher heldout suppressor, and the afftdn-vs-anlmdn contrast moved (DiD -1.39 [-2.14, -0.69], 13 fixed / 3 broken). Training only on WebRTC kHigh/kVeryHigh suppression may match afftdn artefacts better than the uniform 6-21 dB draw and turn the NS contrast negative.
proposals.predicted_signature: NS DiD <= -0.22 on the final readout; afftdn-vs-anlmdn DiD <= -1.70; heldout F1 delta >= +0.5 on both readouts; offline-NS spoof misses <= 29; clean within 0.5.
proposals.falsifier: NS DiD >= +0.32 again -> WebRTC NS exposure does not transfer to ffmpeg suppressors at any level; drop the lever. Offline-NS spoof misses > 29 -> the model learned 'NS => bona'; drop.

proposals.targets: The seed noise behind B4a's +0.57 (merge) / +1.02 (final), currently read only against the mixed 9-run null panel (heldout F1 SD 1.35/1.39). Outside wave B4's search space (seed pinned 1234; the owner declined a B2f replicate at handoff), so it needs an owner decision.
proposals.hypothesis: B2f's half-B WF1 varies by less than 0.5 across seeds, so B4a's gains are above seed noise.
proposals.predicted_signature: B2f seed-1235 half_B WF1 within +-0.5 of 91.98 (merge) and 92.14 (final).
proposals.falsifier: The repeat differs from B2f by >= +0.57 on the merge or >= +1.02 on the final readout -> B4a's gains are inside seed noise.
